what: When the cursor enters a button or comes within 10px of its edge, the button is pulled toward the cursor — .68 times the distance from center to cursor (max 15px), strengthening smoothly (smoothstep) with depth of entry, and tilting up to 2° near corners. It closes 15% of the remaining distance per frame when following and 20% when releasing.
ease: Frame lerp — follow .15 · return .2 (at 60fps, corrected by frame time)

options.dist: Distance at which the pull starts — px outside the border, default 10
options.pull: Pull multiplied by cursor distance, default .68
options.tilt: Maximum tilt angle from the corner (degrees), default 2 — 0 means no tilt
options.follow: Share narrowed each frame when following, default .15
options.back: Share narrowed each frame on release, default .2
